scope: Exact randomization rank requires invariance under the stated phase group. Real anisotropic noise, foreground cleaning, mask effects and harmonic estimation are not fully modeled. Rejection tests this surrogate null and template family, not CCC uniquely.

source.attribution: NASA/WMAP Science Team, LAMBDA/HEASARC; native public scientific products; retain source citations and processing metadata.
source.rights_scope: No blanket license is inferred for third-party papers. Public map-source bytes are linked; this release publishes numerical derivatives and provenance.

processing.processing: Pixel average to RING Nside16; map2alm iter3 lmax32; remove l0,l1; additional 5 degree Gaussian beam; alm2map.
processing.mask: Native KQ85 averaged to Nside16; keep fraction >=0.8 and |Galactic latitude|>=20 degrees.
processing.effective_resolution: Input beams differ; all get the same additional 5-degree smoothing. Not an exact common-beam deconvolution.
processing.scale_scope: Broad 12/18/24 degree Gaussian widths and radial annuli. Not a degree-scale Hawking-point reproduction.

followup.shared_reference_scope: Same processed ILC coefficient magnitudes and independently randomized phases for all products. This changes the reference hypothesis and is a sensitivity diagnostic, not new independent evidence.

frequency_difference.scope: Difference of processed thermodynamic maps sharing the same CMB sky. Different beams, instrument noise and foreground-cleaning residuals remain; not a pure foreground estimator.

followup.scope: Exploratory robustness checks retained alongside the initial predeclared scan. Their ranks are not multiplied, pooled with the original family bound, or interpreted as CCC probabilities.

joint_followup.group_action: One common unit-modulus harmonic phase per l,m across ILC,V,W; real signs for m=0.
joint_followup.preserved: Every per-mode product a_lm^A conjugate(a_lm^B), including auto-power and relative cross-product phase.
joint_followup.scope: Exploratory family-wide conditional phase-group rank, preserving observed product dependence at harmonic level. No independent-products assumption or extra Bonferroni factor is used. Group invariance of real noise/foreground processing remains unestablished; this is not a CCC posterior or a full-instrument detection significance.
